item.title: Taming the Tyrant: Democracy and Political Accountability in Athens and Today — Mon Oct 19, 6:00 PM — Agincourt
item.description:
How much power should a single individual have in a democracy? And how might ordinary citizens hold political elites to account? Dr. Ella Street (PhD, Political Theory, University of Toronto) takes us back to classical Athens to explore these enduring questions. Examining the remarkable institutions and cultural practices Athenians developed to keep their leaders in check, she considers what it really means for the demos—the people—to rule supreme. Despite all that separates ancient and modern democracy, Athens offers surprising lessons for our own moment. As democracies today grapple with powerful individuals—from mayors and heads of state to corporate and technology elites—what might we learn from the Athenians about keeping power in the hands of the people? Register at tpl.ca or by calling 416-396-8943
Source: Toronto Public Library — Older Adults

item.title: ConnectHER Film Festival Toronto Showcase — Thu Oct 29, 6:00 PM — TIFF Lightbox
item.description:
The ConnectHER Film Festival is an international short film festival that amplifies the voices of young filmmakers telling powerful stories about issues affecting women and girls around the world. Now in its 14th year, ConnectHER has received more than 2,250 film submissions from 96 countries, celebrating authentic storytelling and its power to inspire action.
For the first time in the festival's history, ConnectHER is bringing its acclaimed program beyond Austin, Texas, with Toronto becoming the inaugural city to host the ConnectHER Film Festival Showcase, October 29, 2026!
The evening will feature a curated selection of award-winning and audience favorite short films by emerging filmmakers from Palestine, Tibet, Iran, Canada, and beyond, along with a filmmaker Q & A, special guest speakers, and live performances, including writer and comedian, Nour Hadidi!
Join us for an inspiring evening of film, conversation, and music that celebrates the next generation of global storytellers.
